title: A triage pick never preselects an answer on the page
ruling: Owner 13:04 CST Nov 13: on the Cockpit page, a pick triage takes (a stood pick) is not shown as a preselected answer. Triage still takes undoable picks, names the undo and tells the lane; the item stays open with nothing chosen.
quote: in general on this artifact can pick stand's not be preselected answers please
